visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor bouldering gym. A man with black hair and glasses, wearing an olive green Adidas t-shirt, speaks directly to the camera. Behind him, a young girl with pigtails is climbing a colorful rock wall. (2) Close-up on the young girl climbing. She smiles and looks back at the camera. The setting remains the gym with bright indoor lighting. (3) The man is now wearing a red and black safety harness over his pants. He talks to the camera while sitting in the gym lounge area. (4) The man attempts to climb a section of the bouldering wall without a rope. He struggles to find grip, eventually falling onto a thick gray safety mat. (5) A montage of the man climbing a much taller wall with an auto-belay rope. He reaches nearly the top before letting go and rappelling down. (6) Transition to a restaurant. The man sits at a wooden table and uses a fork to eat a waffle topped with nuts and caramel sauce. (7) Dinner scene at home. The man shows a large bowl of salad and then a plate with pork chops and corn soup. The little girl is sitting next to him. (8) Kitchen setting. The man stands at a white counter and holds up a bag of glutinous rice flour. He begins measuring ingredients on a digital scale and mixing them in a glass bowl. (9) He kneads the white dough, boils a small piece in a pot of water on a gas stove, then mixes it back into the raw dough to improve elasticity. (10) He shapes the dough into long, finger-like logs. He then deep-fries them in a small pot of hot oil until they turn golden brown and puffy. (11) The fried logs are placed on a plate of white powdered sugar and coated evenly. (12) The man eats the fried snack, holding it close to the camera to show the texture. He gestures with his hands while describing the flavor. (13) A final short cartoon animation shows two characters against a yellow background.
